title: Muldoon: Americans wanted Kaikoura shut down

tellings.quote: Anyway, he chuckled. And I remember he just let slip something like, "Yeah, the Americans wanted that one shut down pretty quickly."

plain: Robert Muldoon, New Zealand's prime minister around the time of the 1978 Kaikoura UFO sightings off that country's coast, once chuckled and let slip that "the Americans wanted that one shut down pretty quickly." The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells this, recalling what Muldoon said to him. If true, it would mean the United States pressed another government to quiet a UFO case.
